recommended.name: Early Foods Organic Ragi & Almond Cookies
recommended.why_clean: Made with 100% sprouted ragi flour and cold-pressed jaggery with zero refined flour (maida), zero palm oil, zero preservatives, and zero raising agents.
key_improvements: No refined palm oil (uses real butter/ghee)
No artificial additives or raising agents
Sprouted whole millets instead of maida
Rich in dietary fiber (8g vs 1.2g per 100g)

recommended.name: Slurrp Farm 100% Millet Noodles (Foxtail & Little Millet)

key_improvements: Sodium reduced by 45% compared to regular instant noodles
No added MSG or nucleotide enhancers

recommended.name: Organic Tattva Sprouted Ragi Malt
recommended.why_clean: 100% pure sprouted finger millet (ragi) without added sucrose, without liquid glucose syrup, and without artificial caramel colors.
key_improvements: Zero added sugar (0g vs 32.2g per 100g in malt drinks)
Rich in natural bioavailable calcium and iron
No maltodextrin or synthetic flavor additives

recommended.name: The Whole Truth Roasted Makhana (Foxnuts)

High plant protein and low glycemic index
70% lower saturated fat than commercial potato chips
